reason_for_inclusion: Use TLIO only as an additional dataset to test cross-device-form-factor behavior; no TLIO algorithm is implemented or claimed.

prior_exposure.historical_scope: A historical A6 checkpoint and the official RoNIN checkpoint had already been evaluated on TLIO in a separate manuscript workspace.
prior_exposure.consequence: The extension cannot be described as preregistered, prospectively confirmatory, or an untouched external test.

input.claim_boundary: conditional cross-form-factor evaluation; not a raw-IMU-only or deployable TLIO benchmark

reporting.paired_effects: A6 minus comparator by matched seed
reporting.interpretation: cross-device-form-factor stress test of complete pipelines
